chunks: As for what Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisi, from Sayf ibn ʿAmirah, from Ishaq ibn ʿAmmar, who said:
I asked Aba Ibrahim عليه السلام about those who hire out riding animals and travel back and forth every day: is shortened prayer obligatory upon them when they are in travel? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الدَّوَابَّ: riding animals or beasts used for transport
key_terms.الْأَيَّامِ: the days, indicating continual daily occurrence
key_terms.يَخْتَلِفُونَ: they go back and forth repeatedly
key_terms.يُكْرُونَ: they hire out or lease out

ai.seo_question: Do people who travel daily for work still perform shortened prayer during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about people whose work involves frequent travel, such as those who hire out riding animals. Imam Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام states that the ruling of qasr, shortened prayer in travel, applies to them when they are in a state of سفر.
